title: The Origins of Halloween
shared_passage: Watch a video about the history of Halloween. For questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: For the Celts, 31st October was...
options: the last day of the year.
a day to be with their families.
the day they celebrated their music festival.

questions.question: That day, the villagers lit big bonfires...
options: to communicate with the spirits from the spirit world.
to send the ghosts back to their world.

questions.question: All Saints Day...
options: appeared after the Catholic Church had eliminated Samhain (the Celtic celebration).
was used to transform Samhain into a catholic celebration.
was used to eliminate the belief in reincarnation.

questions.question: When the Irish arrived in America, they...
options: introduced Halloween there for the first time.
changed the way Halloween was celebrated.
invented some new traditions, such as bobbing the apple or playing tricks.

questions.question: The neighbours gave candy to the youngsters...
options: so that they didn't vandalise their houses.
in exchange for help with the cleaning.
